lines: Reach a Nether Fortress and return with Nether Wart and a Blaze Rod.
The matter ended well enough. We already settled Nether Wart Warranty.
I remember your first return. You already came back from the Nether Fortress with what we needed.
That chapter is closed. Nether Wart Warranty is closed. I am not sending you through blazes and open lava twice.
That chapter is closed. Your route to the Nether Fortress is already in the brewing notes.
Nothing remains to be earned from this. I remember the day you returned with the Nether Wart.
I will not reopen a finished account. You earned the reward for Nether Wart Warranty, and it was paid.
There is no second payment here. We have the cure because you finished the journey to the Nether Fortress.
Nothing remains to be earned from this. Nothing remains to be recovered from the fortress.
Leave the old tally alone. What you brought from the Nether Fortress is still helping the village.
That chapter is closed. You proved the fortress route once. That is enough.
The matter ended well enough. The brewing notes carries your name beside the completed mark.
Your earlier work still stands. Leave Nether Wart Warranty in the past where it belongs.
The matter ended well enough. You settled every part of Nether Wart Warranty on your first return.
Nothing remains to be earned from this. The Nether Fortress was reached and the Nether Wart evidence delivered.
That chapter is closed. I will find you a road beyond the Nether Fortress before sending you back there.
The matter ended well enough. Nobody forgot what the journey to the Nether Fortress cost you.
What was owed has been paid. Nether Wart Warranty at the Nether Fortress needs no second visit from you.
You finished what I asked. You gave us the Nether Wart, not another rumor.
No one needs this done twice. Nether Wart Warranty ended properly, and it stays ended.
No one needs this done twice. We can look ahead now. Nether Wart Warranty is done.
I will post it when it matters. The conditions for Nether Wart Warranty are not right at the moment.
There is no reason to begin yet. The mark for the Nether Fortress is not open today.
The time is wrong. I have no reason to risk you against blazes and open lava just now.
There is no reason to begin yet. The village is not ready to use Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod.
I am keeping this off the board. Wait until the brewing notes calls for the journey to the Nether Fortress.
Ask me after the stores change. A trip to the Nether Fortress without a need is only danger.
Nothing calls for this work today. The fortress route can stay folded until the timing improves.
Leave that work alone for now. I am holding Nether Wart Warranty off the board for now.
For now, let the matter rest. Nothing at the Nether Fortress needs our answer today.
Ask me after the stores change. Keep your gear ready for the Nether Fortress, but do not leave yet.
There is no reason to begin yet. Nether Wart Warranty is real. The moment for it is not.
We have no need of it yet. I will not send you toward blazes and open lava to satisfy an old note.
For now, let the matter rest. The Nether Fortress can wait until we have a use for the return.
The time is wrong. Ask again after the village reviews the brewing notes.
Not today. There is no active claim on the Nether Wart today.
Not today. The road toward the Nether Fortress is quiet, and I mean to leave it that way.
Leave that work alone for now. Starting Nether Wart Warranty now would spend courage for no useful result.
The board can wait. Nether Wart Warranty has not been posted to any traveler.
Nothing calls for this work today. Give Nether Wart Warranty time to become necessary.
Leave that work alone for now. For the moment, stay on this side of the journey to the Nether Fortress.
No mark is better than a false one. I cannot read a fortress route from here. The Nether is being unusually honest about being hostile.
Something is wrong with the chart. I cannot put a trustworthy mark on the Nether Fortress.
The trail has gone cold. Every route I checked breaks down before the fortress.
My map has failed us. The Nether Fortress maps disagree, and blazes and open lava leave no room for guessing.
The trail has gone cold. I found rumors of the Nether Fortress, but no road I would hand you.
Until I know the way, you stay here. The Nether Fortress has slipped beyond my Nether Fortress charts.
Until I know the way, you stay here. Without a firm bearing, Nether Wart Warranty would be wandering.
Until I know the way, you stay here. My best map is blank where the fortress should be.
No mark is better than a false one. I traced three routes toward the Nether Fortress and trusted none.
A doubtful map is too much risk. The old Nether Fortress directions end before danger begins.
My map has failed us. I will not pretend a guess can mark the Nether Fortress.
I found no safe bearing to give you. No scout has confirmed the mark for the Nether Fortress.
The search turned up nothing solid. The trail to the Nether Fortress went cold before I could mark it.
My map has failed us. I need Nether Fortress coordinates, not campfire stories.
The trail has gone cold. The Nether Fortress may be there, but I cannot prove where.
The old directions no longer agree. None of the Nether Fortress bearings lead to the same ground.
The trail has gone cold. Let me find an honest fortress route before you prepare to leave.
I will not guess at a route. The brewing notes offers warnings today, not directions.
I will not guess at a route. The Nether Fortress map gives me doubt when I need certainty.
My map has failed us. Come back after the road to the Nether Fortress gives us an answer.
The evidence still matters. Bring Nether Wart. The whole request is written around it.
The proof has to reach my hands. The Nether Wart is still missing from your return.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. I cannot close the brewing notes without the agreed Nether Wart evidence.
The evidence still matters. You faced the Nether Fortress, but the village still needs the Nether Wart.
Your word is not the missing piece. Bring back Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod before we settle Nether Wart Warranty.
The evidence still matters. Your story may be true. I still need the Nether Wart.
What you carried home decides this. The journey to the Nether Fortress ends here when the Nether Wart changes hands.
I cannot sign off on an empty return. Do not reach the Nether Fortress and forget the Nether Wart that verifies it.
I cannot sign off on an empty return. I know you traveled. I need a result from the Nether Fortress.
The evidence still matters. The Nether Wart Warranty reward waits on the Nether Wart evidence, not the telling.
Your word is not the missing piece. Show me the Nether Wart, and Nether Wart Warranty can close.
Your word is not the missing piece. The empty place in the brewing notes waits for what you recovered.
I believe you went, but that is not enough. Words cannot stand in for the cure.
Show me what came back with you. Check your packs before you make the journey to the Nether Fortress twice.
You returned without the one thing I asked for. Nether Wart Warranty named its proof from the beginning.
Bring back something the village can verify. Bring the Nether Wart evidence here rather than leaving it in storage.
I need something I can hold. The village asked for Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod, and that remains unfinished.
I believe you went, but that is not enough. I can record the fortress route after I see what came from it.
I cannot sign off on an empty return. One Nether Wart handoff separates Nether Wart Warranty from completion.
The last requirement is still missing. Return when the Nether Wart is in your hands.
You have not gone far enough yet. Nether Wart without the fortress route is a guess. I need the place confirmed.
You have not gone far enough yet. You have not confirmed the Nether Fortress itself.
You cannot skip the heart of the task. The cargo means little if the Nether Fortress was never reached.
I need the site confirmed. Nether Wart Warranty includes the road as well as the return.
Going near it does not count. Set foot in the fortress before you bring me evidence.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. I asked for proof from the Nether Fortress, not somewhere else.
The place itself must be reached. The Nether Fortress remains untouched in the brewing notes.
The place itself must be reached. Finish the outward journey before claiming the Nether Wart Warranty reward.
You cannot skip the heart of the task. A borrowed Nether Wart cannot replace reaching the Nether Fortress.
You have not gone far enough yet. The Nether Fortress map still says you stopped short.
Finish the outward journey first. Go to the marked place and see Nether Wart Warranty through there.
I need the site confirmed. The fortress route must end at the Nether Fortress, not near it.
The map still shows unfinished travel. I need your eyes on the Nether Fortress before I trust the report.
Finish the outward journey first. Do not skip the part that puts blazes and open lava in front of you.
The map still shows unfinished travel. The village asked you to confirm the fortress existed.
Reaching the mark is part of the promise. Your return is early. the Nether Fortress still waits.
The road must end where I sent you. Reach the Nether Fortress, then recover Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod.
I need the site confirmed. The journey to the Nether Fortress is not complete while the final mark is unvisited.
This task was never only about the cargo. The brewing notes needs a confirmed place, not only an item.
This task was never only about the cargo. Turn back toward the Nether Fortress and finish what you began.
You are not finished yet. Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}. Nether Wart is the cure. A <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod proves you reached the heat of it.
Stay with the work you accepted. The Nether Fortress is still near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Before you leave, hear this again. The mark remains near {target_x}, {target_z}, so keep to the planned fortress route.
Remember what the village is waiting for. Check the map again. Nether Fortress is still near {target_x}, {target_z}.
The job still has loose ends. Nether Wart Warranty still calls for Nether Wart and one <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod.
Hold to the instructions I gave you. Watch for blazes and open lava on the way in.
Bring this to a proper finish. Do not leave the Nether Fortress without the Nether Wart.
Keep the return trip in your plans. Your return should give us the cure.
Before you leave, hear this again. Check the Nether Fortress bearing at {target_x}, {target_z} before landmarks blur.
Remember what the village is waiting for. Keep the Nether Wart safe once you recover it.
Do not let one finished step distract you. The brewing notes stays open until you come home.
Stay with the work you accepted. Do not rush blind toward the Nether Fortress. Follow the mark and return whole.
You are not finished yet. The Nether Fortress has not moved from {target_x}, {target_z}.
You are not finished yet. Remember why you are going. We need to secure medicine from the fortress.
Do not let one finished step distract you. If the fortress route feels wrong, check your position against {target_x}, {target_z}.
Stay with the work you accepted. The hard part is reaching the fortress and leaving with evidence.
Bring this to a proper finish. Nether Fortress still waits near {target_x}, {target_z}.
Hold to the instructions I gave you. Bring every part of Nether Wart and one <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod back together.
Keep the whole task in mind. I would rather wait than receive half the agreed Nether Wart.
Keep the whole task in mind. Find the Nether Fortress, do Nether Wart Warranty there, and return to me.

Before you agree, hear all of it. The fortress mark sits {direction}, about {distance} blocks away, near {target_x}, {target_z}. Bring Nether Wart and one <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod.
Before you agree, hear all of it. I marked the Nether Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}.
There is a reason I chose you. Travel {direction} for about {distance} blocks and look for the fortress.
Take the task only if you are ready. The job is to secure medicine from the fortress.
Let us be clear about the job. Come home with Nether Wart and one <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod so the village has more than rumors.
Take the task only if you are ready. The road leads through blazes and open lava, so prepare before leaving.
Take the task only if you are ready. I need someone willing to reach the Nether Fortress and return with proof.
Listen closely. The Nether Fortress sits near {target_x}, {target_z}, according to my map.
Here is the work. Follow the {direction} bearing and keep the brewing notes dry.
Take this seriously. Nether Wart Warranty begins at the Nether Fortress and ends when the Nether Wart reaches me.
Here is the work. The Nether Fortress mark is about {distance} blocks away. Do not mistake speed for care.
I am trusting you with something important. Bring Nether Wart and one <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod, and I can turn this risk into something useful.
Before you agree, hear all of it. The village needs the cure, not boasting at the fire.
I have a difficult request. I trust you with the fortress route because it is not kind.
I need you to see this through. Make for {target_x}, {target_z} and confirm the Nether Fortress yourself.
Let us be clear about the job. Prepare for blazes and open lava before crossing the last safe ground.
I am trusting you with something important. The outward journey proves the Nether Fortress map. The return proves you.
This needs a careful hand. Do not come back empty from the fortress.
I am trusting you with something important. Take Nether Wart Warranty only if you mean to finish the travel and recovery.
Take the task only if you are ready. When you have Nether Wart and one <gradient:gold:red><pulse>Blaze</pulse></gradient> Rod, bring it straight here.
You saw it through. That will brew into more than medicine. It will brew into confidence. Take your reward.
The village can use this. You reached the Nether Fortress and brought the Nether Wart home.
The hard part is behind us. The brewing notes finally has a true ending.
You brought the work to a proper end. This is the cure, solid enough to hold.
You saw it through. The village can secure medicine from the fortress because you took the risk.
You brought the work to a proper end. I asked for Nether Wart and one Blaze Rod, and you returned with every part.
Good, you made it back. You went through blazes and open lava and kept your head.
You saw it through. The fortress route is confirmed now, not merely drawn.
This will make a real difference. I can pay Nether Wart Warranty without a doubt.
Good, you made it back. The Nether Wart tells the story better than any boast.
I am glad to see you home. You made the dangerous road to the Nether Fortress useful to everyone here.
That is the result I needed. The Nether Fortress is no longer just a warning on a map.
You brought the work to a proper end. I will put your Nether Fortress findings where the village can study them.
This return was worth waiting for. Nether Wart Warranty is clean, even if the journey to the Nether Fortress was not.
Now I can close the ledger. That is the Nether Wart evidence I hoped to see.
This return was worth waiting for. You returned from the Nether Fortress with more than survival. You brought an answer.
You saw it through. Nether Wart Warranty closes with the village better prepared.
Now I can close the ledger. The next traveler to the Nether Fortress will have your route.
Now I can close the ledger. Take the Nether Wart Warranty reward. You earned it beyond the safe roads.
The village can use this. I am glad to see both the Nether Wart and person carrying it.
You are not ready for this request. This request needs steadier hands than you have shown me so far.
I cannot trust you with this yet. Nether Wart Warranty demands trust I do not have in you yet.
This calls for someone we know better. I cannot hand you a route through blazes and open lava today.
I cannot trust you with this yet. The Nether Fortress is no ground for an untested ally.
No, the risk is too high. Do steadier work here before asking for the Nether Fortress map.
No, the risk is too high. I need someone I can trust to return from the Nether Fortress.
Earn our confidence before asking again. The brewing notes stays closed to you for now.
The village needs a steadier hand. Nether Wart Warranty risks more than the traveler's life.
The answer is no for now. Earn our confidence, then ask about the fortress again.
I need proof of your judgment first. I will not send a stranger after the cure.
The answer is no for now. The Nether Fortress is dangerous enough without doubt between us.
The village needs a steadier hand. Your name has not reached the trusted page of the brewing notes.
This work is not yours today. There are safer tasks than Nether Wart Warranty that can show me how you work.
I will not place this burden on you. I need proof of judgment before offering the journey to the Nether Fortress.
I will not place this burden on you. For now, the Nether Fortress map remains folded.
You are not ready for this request. The village is not ready to stake secure medicine from the fortress on you.
The answer is no for now. Ask about the Nether Fortress after you have stood with us longer.
No, the risk is too high. Courage may reach the Nether Fortress. Reliability brings the Nether Wart home.
I will not place this burden on you. Nether Wart Warranty stays with proven hands.
This calls for someone we know better. I will tell you when we trust you with the road to the Nether Fortress.
The blaze rod proves the route.
Bring 1 blaze rod so the cleric knows the fortress was real.
